newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CLOSES UP, RADIOKOMUNIKACE SURGES.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CLOSES UP, RADIOKOMUNIKACE SURGES.

text.p: The Czech PX50 edged higher on Wednesday, rising almost one percent to 546.7 led by gains to most blue chips.

Among the biggest gainers of the day was Ceske Radiokomunikace which was up 71 crowns to 4,191. On Tuesday TeleDanmark annunced it had acquired a 21 percent stake on the open market in the company which is 70 percent owned by the state.
Dealers said there was a clear connection between Wednesday's performance on the bourse and Tuesday's announcement.
"Definitely it has a very strong connection," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
Radiokomunikace is a telecommunications transmission firm which analysts say could be a logical competitor to SPT Telecom when that company's monopoly ends in the year 2000.
SPT itself also had a good day, closing up 50 crowns to 4,390. Komercni Banka rose by the same amount to 2,045.
